title: Programming Goods
body:
**Programming Goods** transforms programming concepts into Minecraft gameplay.

Discover Java Objects underground, craft powerful programming-inspired tools, compile unique consumables using the Java Compiler Table, explore new ores, foods, armor and weapons, and prepare for future languages like Python and C++.

**Current features:**

- **Blocks:** Java Coffee Block, Java Stone, Java Stone Bricks, Java Smooth Stone, Array Fuel Block and Java Compiler Table to craft unique consumable items.
- **Items:** Java Object, Java Coffee, Java Node.
- **Ores:** Java Object Ore.
- **Food Items:** Java Juice, Java Apple, Java Rotten Flesh and Java Data Structures set.
- **Fuel Items:** Array Fuel.
- **Mobs:** Java Golem.
- **Armor:** New full Java armor set.
- **Weapons and tools:** A new tier of powerful java weapons and tools.
- **Zones:** Java Deepslate zone.
- **Structures:** Java Laboratory.

New content is in current development.

**Important note:** Download the latest .jar file to see all the features the mod currently has.
